title: LatexDo 0.3.0
summary: Faster compiles, reworked citations, and a reviewer workspace.

highlights.title: Reworked compilation engine
highlights.description: Iterative compiles for large documents are noticeably faster, with clearer failing-command diagnostics.

highlights.title: Citations overhauled
highlights.description: Insert and preview citations inline, with warning badges for incomplete or duplicate keys.

highlights.title: Reviewer workspace
highlights.description: A dedicated sidebar for comments, change tracking, and conflict resolution during reviews.

fixes: Fixed an intermittent failure reading PDF previews immediately after a recompile.
Fixed a crash when opening projects with deeply nested include trees.
Fixed citation warnings misreporting keys inside escaped environments.
